Step: 1871 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100).  
From 1871-08-10, add 262 days:  
Days remaining in August: 21 (from Aug 10 inclusive: 31-10+1 = 22? Actually 10 to 31 is 22 days, but starting on 10th, adding 21 days reaches Aug 31).  
Let’s count:  
Aug 10 + 21 days = Aug 31 (21 days later, total so far: 21).  
Remaining: 262 - 21 = 241 days.  

Sept (30) → 241 - 30 = 211  
Oct (31) → 211 - 31 = 180  
Nov (30) → 180 - 30 = 150  
Dec (31) → 150 - 31 = 119  
End at Dec 31, 1871.  

Now 119 days into 1872 (leap year).  
Jan 31 → 119 - 31 = 88  
Feb 29 → 88 - 29 = 59  
Mar 31 → 59 - 31 = 28  
Apr 30 → 28 - 30 = -2 → means April 28.  

Check: April has 30 days, so April 28 is 28 days into April.  
Thus: 1872-04-28.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1872-04-28
